suggestions.suggestion: Implement a ReplayMovieSpec-compatible intermediate representation for all video types
suggestions.details: BAS already has a rich ReplayMovieSpec format (version 2025-11-07) that describes frames, cursor motion, theme, watermarks, intro/outro cards, and playback settings as JSON. Rather than inventing a new video description format, extend or adopt ReplayMovieSpec as the universal IR for Video Studio. Browser recordings from BAS already produce this format natively. Desktop recordings and motion graphics can emit compatible specs. This means the FFmpeg compositing pipeline only needs one input format, and BAS's existing renderer can be reused or adapted for the final encode step.

suggestions.suggestion: Add an asset manifest and artifact storage layer from day one (P0)
suggestions.details: Both BAS and S2D already have artifact storage patterns (BAS uses MinIO/S3-compatible + file-based storage with content-type detection; S2D stores video paths in smoke test status JSON). Video Studio will produce multiple intermediate artifacts per video (raw recordings, scripts, composited segments, final renders). Designing a structured artifact manifest early — with retention policies and storage backend abstraction — prevents the 'scattered files' problem that made S2D's recordings non-reusable in the first place. This also enables the template system (P1) to reference stored assets.

suggestions.suggestion: Expose a webhook/callback mechanism for async video completion
suggestions.details: Video rendering (especially compositing multiple segments) can take minutes. Rather than requiring callers to poll, Video Studio should accept a callback URL or emit an event when a video job completes. This integrates naturally with the marketing crew workflow (content-creator submits brief → gets notified when video is ready for review) and with any future scenario that wants to request videos. The swarm-manager's existing task notification pattern could serve as the event backbone.
